title: Word Roots · Q3 W09 D02
objective: Identify a base word, or root, in common related words.
introduction: Milo found the base word work inside worked! 🐱✨ Look for the base word in related words.

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: Work is the base word, and worked is made from it, so the pair shares a root.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'worked'?
items.explanation: Worked is work with -ed added, so work is the base word.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'work'?
items.explanation: Worked is made from the root work by adding -ed.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: "cat — dog" names two animals, not a word family. The other pairs share a base word and a related word.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'writer'?
items.explanation: Writer is write with -er added, so write is the base word.
